location: p. 409 (PDF p. 4), Studies 1a and 1b—Discussion, opening paragraph
quote: Across two studies, individuals who were high in private self- ... consciousness but not those who were low in self-consciousness ... showed greater responsivity to a manipulation that is typically ... interpreted as affecting behavior in an automatic fashion.
reason: In Hull et al. (2002) Study 1a, the unmoderated elderly-prime main effect on walking speed only approached significance (F(1, 27) = 2.47, p = .13) while the Self-Consciousness x Prime interaction was significant (F(1, 27) = 4.44, p < .05), and the authors explicitly conclude that high but not low private self-conscious individuals showed the priming effect (mixed).
